question: How does matrika bind knowledge?
inference: The verse explains matrika as binder and foundation.
plain_english: Knowledge foundation is matrika; this threefold impurity form is incomplete notion distinct object appearance from a to ksha. Unknown mother matrika binds; known mother supports world mother. Limited knowledge says I am incomplete. Word-mixed knowledge binds. Consciousness power in heart is brahma noose. Eight kalas and six paths arise. Powers constantly arise. Now true principle of bondage pacification is taught.
